method: Independent model linguistic review of ALL80 exact selected Spanish noun definitions, proposed English renderings and contexts, read in two40-record batches. Each English meaning checked against its supplied source sense, including referent/material/semantic number and qualifications. Original model review, not source-membership-only approval, native-human certification, examples or production edits. No other reviewer conclusions were consulted.

guards: Exact word/POS/raw record hash/zero-based selected sense/English/context only; not a morphological family or synonym merge.
Do not certify unreviewed Spanish source gender/number/countability in the English meaning panel. Semantically plural English AJUAGAS ulcers remains plural.
Preserve historical belief ALIDONA and historical levy ALAMINA/ALMAJA contexts; clinical AZOEMIA is a word meaning, not diagnosis.
Keep rare/obsolete/literary/regional/derogatory and technical usage labels. Do not substitute a Mexican-only claim when source has another region or none.
No invented quotations, examples, actual puzzle referents, medical treatments, current legal obligations or unsupported numerical conversions.
